title: Regulatory incident report
description: Printout of an incident report submitted to a federal agency's online reporting system: DOE Form OE-417, a National Response Center report, FCC NORS outage report, PHMSA incident report, CISA incident report, FAA Part 107 accident report, or a bank's notice to its federal regulator. Agency header, report type, submission receipt, sections of labelled answers and a narrative. The agency is real; the organization and people are simulated.

agencyOffice.description: Office or program within the agency
examples: Office of Cybersecurity, Energy Security, and Emergency Response (CESER)

formName.description: Name of the form or reporting system
examples: Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report

ombNumber.description: OMB control number and expiry printed on the form

reportType.description: Initial (emergency alert / notification), update, or final report

reportId.description: Report or confirmation number the agency assigned

submittedAt.description: When it was submitted, with time zone

examples: Eastside 138 kV Substation and Energy Management System

incidentStart.description: When the incident began, with time zone

sections.description: Sections of the form, each a list of labelled answers (2-6 sections, 2-10 items each). A long report continues on further pages.

heading.description: Section heading as on the form

narrative.description: Narrative description of the event as entered (3-6 sentences; blank lines separate paragraphs)
examples: At 14:52 EDT operators observed unauthorized breaker commands issued from the EMS to the Eastside substation.

status.description: Submission status line printed by the system
examples: Received by DOE. Your report has been forwarded to the E-ISAC.

marking.description: Exercise marking printed above and below the form
